== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Power changes from 3 to 2 and deploy from 2 to 3. The printed starfighter deploy and move permission is removed. The later cancellation costs 1 Force. The Holotable full card adds ‘here’ during battle. The participation definition on glossary page 53 establishes the same location.
